title: albizia turgida
intro: Albizia turgida, commonly known as the purple silk tree, is a plant species belonging to the legume family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as its use as an antiseptic and anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Albizia turgida include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, and its use in the treatment of skin conditions and wounds. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
